jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Lead
jobs.why: Healthcare AI operations role spanning customer onboarding, deployment pipelines, scalable process documentation, dashboards, vendor management and cross-functional execution. Kevin’s ABA/healthcare operations, training, intake, automation and systems-building background maps unusually well.
jobs.gap: Clarion prefers 2–4 years in consulting, investment banking, business operations or a high-growth startup. Kevin should frame his healthcare operations and systems ownership as the equivalent operating experience and be comfortable with a fully in-person NYC environment.

jobs.title: Enterprise Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare technology implementation role owning enterprise onboarding, cross-functional delivery, customer relationships, adoption and process execution. Kevin’s healthcare operations, stakeholder coordination, onboarding, training and systems/project work are highly transferable.
jobs.gap: Arcadia prefers 3+ years leading healthcare software implementations and experience with claims/clinical data integration. Kevin should position his healthcare systems implementation work clearly but not claim technical integration expertise he does not have.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: End-to-end healthcare software implementation, project leadership, executive/client meetings, risk management and cross-functional coordination fit Kevin’s project-management, onboarding, training and healthcare operations experience.
jobs.gap: The posting seeks healthcare software implementation and claims/clinical data integration experience. Kevin should keep SQL described only as foundational/working knowledge and avoid implying deep healthcare-data integration expertise.

jobs.title: Human Resources Operations Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare-company operations role focused on scalable processes and systems, recruiting-to-offboarding workflows, data integrity, compliance and cross-functional execution. Kevin’s healthcare recruiting, onboarding, training, compliance workflows and operational automation are strongly transferable.
jobs.gap: The role owns core HR functions including compensation, benefits, HRIS and payroll, where Kevin has less direct depth. Five-day in-office attendance is also a meaningful constraint.

jobs.title: Campaign Operations Manager
jobs.why: Operations-heavy growth role at a behavioral AI company where Kevin’s marketing background can support his stronger workflow, reporting, process and cross-functional execution skills. It provides a six-figure remote path without making SEO the core responsibility.
jobs.gap: The role is closer to campaign/revenue operations than healthcare operations, so Kevin should emphasize operational systems, measurement and execution rather than general marketing or SEO.

jobs.title: Business Operations (Graduate)
jobs.why: Generalist business-operations role that explicitly values automating real work with AI tools. Kevin’s workflow automation, Power Apps, Salesforce, reporting and hands-on operational systems experience provides a differentiated fit.
jobs.gap: The graduate framing may make Kevin look overexperienced in some areas while the company may expect a specific early-career profile. It is outside healthcare and should rank below stronger healthcare-operations matches.
